notes: This is a starter library. null/empty fields are intentionally left for manual completion.
Character roster was taken from the current Genshin.gg Honkai: Star Rail character list.
Acheron, Cyrene and Evernight build fields were directly checked against their current Genshin.gg character pages.
Overall rating and role are editorial/gameplay judgements rather than immutable game data; keep their source/version alongside them when you fill them.
Honkai: Star Rail also has the Erudition path, which should be included in your enum even though it was missing from the original requested path list.
Trailblazer forms are separate entries because their element/path/build changes by form.

2026-09-23: genshin.gg spells Boothill as "Boothiill" on the roster page; JSON keeps the in-game spelling "Boothill" (thumb 3020). Sync script must alias these.
2026-09-23: live roster contains Black Swan and Bronya, which are absent from this file; the sync script should add them as stubs.
